lines.1: 「If I had an assault rifle, I'd have filled you with holes. Lucky you, huh?」
lines.2: 「...You fight with Inori sometimes, but you still love her.」
lines.3: 「Sure. We've known each other a long time.」
lines.5: 「Hold it. I'm not answering anything. Since when does a bird answer a human's questions?」
lines.6: 「Wait! There are so many things wrong with that!」
